familyFindings.lighting: Recognizable and distinct silhouettes, but shared flat-vector treatment, shallow material/light response and insufficient three-quarter collectible depth; all 12 current hashes require rework.
familyFindings.wall: All 12 read as clean UI-style emblems floating on nearly identical gradient cards rather than premium physical wall objects. Frames, glass, metal, wood, neon, mirror and crest materials lack convincing depth; several assigned themes are expressed mostly by palette. Tier progression is graphic complexity rather than richer construction/materials.
familyFindings.rugs: All 12 are readable symbols, but they are presented upright and floating like badges/signs, not floor textiles in three-quarter room/product perspective. Pile/weave/edge thickness and contact with a floor plane are largely absent; higher tiers add glow/ornament without premium textile/material progression.

reviews.name: Starter Lamp
reviews.reason: Clear starter lamp, but flat outlined shade/base and shallow fabric/metal lighting; rebuild as dimensional lamp and keep UI/tier chrome outside artwork.

reviews.name: Cloud Lamp
reviews.reason: Cloud lamp identity reads, but body is a flat silhouette and Pixel Party is weak; add diffuser volume, hardware and pixel-specific material/light detail.

reviews.name: Pixel Cube Light
reviews.reason: Distinct cube silhouette, but flat polygon faces and weak emitted light/Berry Blast construction; needs convincing volume and emissive pixel depth.

reviews.name: Heart Lamp
reviews.reason: Heart identity is clear but reads as a flat cutout; Garden Glow is not materially expressed and Tier 2 needs diffuser thickness, dimensional base/stem and richer light.

reviews.name: Vine Light
reviews.reason: Distinct vine fixture, but stems/leaves/bulbs are flat and Galaxy Glow is weak; needs dimensional botanical structure and emissive/material depth.

reviews.name: Planet Lamp
reviews.reason: Strong planet/ring concept and readable palette, but globe/ring/tripod remain flat bands; add real volume, occlusion, construction and product lighting.

reviews.name: Sun Lamp
reviews.reason: Sunburst reads instantly, but is a flat yellow graphic and Aqua Wave is weak; needs sculpted radial construction, diffuser depth and themed light treatment.

reviews.name: Bubble Lamp
reviews.reason: Bubble cluster is distinct, but globes look like UI circles rather than glass; add refraction/specular depth, spatial overlap, stand construction and stronger Art Attack expression.

reviews.name: Color Lamp
reviews.reason: Promising faceted prism identity, but flat fills lack crystal refraction, edge thickness, mounting and luxe emitted-light depth.

reviews.name: Neon Strip Tower
reviews.reason: Theme/identity are strong, but tower remains a flat frontal panel; Tier 4 needs three-quarter chassis depth, surface response and layered neon spill.

reviews.name: Aurora Light
reviews.reason: Aurora/candy direction reads, but ribbons are flat strokes over a generic base; needs translucent/emissive layered depth and a dimensional support.

reviews.name: Crystal Chandelier
reviews.reason: Chandelier is recognizable, but highest tier lacks crystal refraction, metal volume, suspended depth and sufficiently rich themed hero lighting.

reviews.name: School Star Poster
reviews.reason: Poster identity is readable, but it is a flat framed UI illustration with little paper/frame depth; Garden Glow is weak. Give the physical poster/frame believable material separation and dimensional mounting while keeping Tier 1 simple.

reviews.name: Cloud Wall Flag
reviews.reason: Pennant/cloud shape is clear, but cloth hangs as a flat badge and Galaxy Glow is mostly background color. Add fabric drape/thickness, mounting hardware and galaxy-specific print/material treatment.

reviews.name: Pixel Scoreboard
reviews.reason: Scoreboard identity and pixels read well, but housing/display are flat and Sunny Pop lacks material identity. Add enclosure thickness, screen/emissive depth and simple sunny accents without overbuilding Tier 1.

reviews.name: Heart Gallery
reviews.reason: Four-frame gallery is distinct, but frames/art remain flat icon tiles and Aqua Wave is largely palette. Add varied frame thickness, glass/paper response, wall-mount depth and stronger aqua/wave material storytelling.

reviews.name: Garden Garland
reviews.reason: Garland silhouette is appropriate and readable, but vine/leaves/stars are thin flat shapes with little suspension depth; Art Attack is weak. Add cord/leaf material, layered overlaps/shadows and art-specific handmade detail.

reviews.name: Planet Map
reviews.reason: Orbital plaque reads clearly, but all geometry is flat and Star Luxe does not feel materially premium. Add plaque/frame depth, raised/metallic orbital details and richer luxe surface/light response.

reviews.name: Skate Poster
reviews.reason: Skate/neon concept is readable, but it is still a flat poster icon on the same template. Tier 3 needs believable framed/poster material, neon/ink depth and more premium wall-object lighting.

reviews.name: Ocean Window
reviews.reason: Window/ocean read is clear, but panes, waves and fish are flat layers with no glass/recess/refraction depth and Candy Core is weak. Rebuild as a dimensional inset window with layered water/glass treatment.

reviews.name: Art Gallery Wall
reviews.reason: Gallery-grid concept is recognizable, but reads like four flat UI thumbnails rather than mounted art; Adventure Club is not specific. Add varied frame/material depth and adventure-specific artwork while keeping the multi-frame composition.

reviews.name: Neon City Sign
reviews.reason: Neon skyline sign reads and glows, but remains a flat rectangular icon; Cloud Pop is not expressed and Tier 4 lacks tube/housing/wall-spill depth. Build actual neon-tube construction with dimensional mounting and themed silhouette/material cues.

reviews.name: Star Mirror
reviews.reason: Star shape is clear, but the center does not convincingly read as reflective glass and Pixel Party is weak. Tier 4 needs mirror reflection/specular cues, frame thickness/mounting and richer pixel-specific detailing.

reviews.name: Golden Crest
reviews.reason: Crest/star identity is strong, but the highest tier is a flat badge with layered strokes rather than sculpted gold/enamel relief. Give Tier 5 convincing metal/enamel thickness, beveled ornament, mounting and controlled hero lighting.

reviews.name: Starter Mat
reviews.reason: Pattern is readable, but the item floats upright like a sign rather than lying on a floor. Rebuild as a simple three-quarter mat with visible weave/edge thickness, floor contact and Aqua Wave textile cues.

reviews.name: Cloud Rug
reviews.reason: Cloud silhouette reads, but it is a floating cloud badge with no textile pile/floor perspective and Art Attack is weak. Keep the playful shape but show actual rug thickness, fibers/tufting and handmade art accents.

reviews.name: Pixel Grid Rug
reviews.reason: Grid/star design is clear, but reads as a vertical display panel. Show it as a floor rug with pile/border thickness, perspective foreshortening and restrained Star Luxe yarn/trim rather than a glowing plaque.

reviews.name: Heart Rug
reviews.reason: Heart/neon motif is strong, but the item is an upright glowing heart badge, not a floor textile. Convert to three-quarter rug geometry with plush/stitched edge depth and neon-thread or luminous-piping treatment.

reviews.name: Leaf Rug
reviews.reason: Leaf shape and veins are readable, but it floats vertically with no pile/weave or floor contact. Add textile construction, thickness/edge fibers and candy-specific material/color depth in floor perspective.

reviews.name: Orbit Rug
reviews.reason: Orbit motif is attractive, but the circular item reads as a wall medallion/badge. Show a foreshortened round rug with actual tufting/stitched orbital pattern and more specific Adventure Club exploration cues.

reviews.name: Checker Rug
reviews.reason: Checker pattern reads, but the object is an upright rounded rectangle; Tier 3 still lacks floor perspective, pile, edge construction and plush Cloud Pop depth.

reviews.name: Wave Rug
reviews.reason: Layered wave silhouette is distinct, but it floats like a logo and Pixel Party is not strongly expressed. Convert to a floor rug with stacked/tufted bands, edge thickness and pixel-texture accents.

reviews.name: Splash Rug
reviews.reason: Splash/berry palette is readable, but again appears as a floating emblem. Add floor perspective, plush uneven pile/edge detail and richer berry-paint textile material rather than glow-only depth.

reviews.name: Neon Grid Rug
reviews.reason: Grid/arrows are clear but the object looks like a standing neon display, not a rug; Garden Glow is only green color. Tier 4 needs floor-plane perspective, textile/material depth and botanical/luminous-thread treatment.

reviews.name: Dream Cloud Rug
reviews.reason: Cloud/moon/galaxy design is appealing, but floats like a cloud icon and lacks premium textile/floor realism. Give it deep plush pile, shaped edge thickness, foreshortening and richer Galaxy Glow fibers/light.

reviews.name: Luxe Star Rug
reviews.reason: Star/sun palette is clear, but highest tier is a floating layered star badge with no rug category realism. Rebuild as an unmistakable floor textile with luxe pile/trim, dimensional stitched/gem-like accents and spectacular but controlled Sunny Pop presentation.
